Shot down · Romania

Spanish NATO jet downs drone reported as Russian near Galați, Romania

16 August 2026 · Băleni · Cudalbi

Reported foreign

On 16 August 2026 a drone was shot down between Băleni and Cudalbi in Galați County, Romania, about 24 km from Galați. It had reportedly entered Romanian airspace through Moldova. A Spanish F/A-18 fighter assigned to NATO engaged it above an uninhabited area.

The drone was reported as Russian, and a NATO account described its origin as apparently Russian. Earlier reporting gave its type as Geran-2, but its exact type has not been independently verified. The shoot-down itself has been confirmed.

No casualties were reported, and no payload details were given. The wreckage was recovered and investigated.
